today_paragraph: Siemens Healthineers closed at €41.87, up 0.3% today. The daily trend is up: price is above its 20-day average, which is above the 50-day. The overall score is leaning bullish (+31), with one caution on the daily chart: RSI 71, overbought, pullback more likely. Over the last month it has beaten the medical-device ETF (IHI) by 4 points. There are no US-listed options on this stock, so the options sections are left out. Next up: Siemens Healthineers earnings (before open) in 13 days. Earnings have moved it about ±4% on average.
